aboutPage.bodyHtml:
Eagle Bed at a glance

  • Who we are: Eagle Bed, a bed maker in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. [OWNER TO CONFIRM: is it right to call Eagle Bed "family-run"? The current page says so.]
  • What we make: fully upholstered beds only: panel, wingback, TV, Chesterfield, ottoman gas-lift, divan and kids' beds, plus headboards and mattresses. We do not make wooden or metal beds.
  • Where: every bed is made to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury.
  • Delivery: free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) by our own team, usually in 3 to 5 working days. Northern Ireland, Jersey, Guernsey and the Isle of Man: £90.
  • Returns: 14-day free returns, and we collect for free.
  • Warranty: 5-year frame warranty. Mattresses: 5-year guarantee.
  • Phone: 07417 439197, Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm. Email: eaglebedofficial@gmail.com

Who we are

Eagle Bed makes upholstered beds in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, and sells them online at eaglebed.co.uk. If you search for "Eagle Bed", this is us: the Dewsbury bed maker. Other websites sell a bed design called the "Eagle Bed Frame", but that is a product name used by other sellers, not our company. [OWNER TO CONFIRM: Eagle Bed has no link to ukbedsdirect.com.]

Our Dewsbury workshop

Every Eagle Bed is built and upholstered to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury. Each bed is made for one customer, in the size, fabric and colour that customer chooses, so the bed that arrives is made for your room rather than taken off a shelf.

How a bed is made

  1. You choose. Pick a design, a size (Kids Single 2ft6, Single 3ft, Small Double 4ft, Double 4ft6, King 5ft or Super King 6ft), a fabric and a colour.
  2. We build the frame. Each bed is built on a solid wood frame with a slatted base. Ottoman beds can have a gas-lift base that lifts the whole mattress platform for storage underneath.
  3. We upholster it by hand. The frame and headboard are covered by hand in your chosen fabric, with details such as button tufting on our Chesterfield designs or stitched channels on our panel designs.
  4. We deliver it. Our own team brings it to your door, usually within 3 to 5 working days of your order.

Fabrics

Choose from Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé. Fabrics come in solid colours, stripes and two-tone finishes. Want to see a colour first? Request free fabric swatches before you order.

Delivery

Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales), with no minimum spend. Delivery to Northern Ireland, Jersey, Guernsey and the Isle of Man costs £90. We use our own delivery team, and we contact you to arrange a delivery window once your order is ready. Full details are on our delivery information page.

Returns

You can return an item within 14 days, free of charge: we collect it at no cost to you. The item must be unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. If something arrives faulty, damaged or wrong, contact us within 14 days and we will arrange a free replacement or a full refund. For hygiene reasons, mattresses cannot be returned once the packaging is opened, unless faulty. Read the full returns policy.

Warranty

Every Eagle Bed frame and headboard has a 5-year warranty covering faults in materials and workmanship under normal home use. Mattresses come with a 5-year guarantee. See the warranty page for full terms.

Ways to pay

Pay by card, PayPal, Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Cash on delivery is also possible: please call or email us to arrange it. More on our finance options page.

Contact Eagle Bed

Call 07417 439197 (Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com. You can also use our contact page.

Follow us: Facebook, Instagram and TikTok.
